day_shape: 42 items: UKMTO reports tanker struck by projectile in Strait of Hormuz, Grand Ayatollah Shabiri Zanjani's death dominates IRIB cycle, IDF says it killed two Oct 7 infiltrators and a Nukhba commander in Gaza, Tehran warns of 'sustained' response to any new US strike; no UK Parliament or OFAC items.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident and US posture
threads.summary: IRIB relayed a UKMTO report that a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unidentified projectile, injuring two crew; Iran International reported Tehran pairing diplomatic overtures with Hormuz warnings as Trump weighed options. CENTCOM posted that its forces have redirected 109 commercial vessels as of Sept 20 and highlighted USS John Finn operations in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Tehran threatens sustained response to US
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Iran International reported Iran's military threatening 'sustained' attacks on US bases and interests across the region if struck again, with parliament speaker Ghalibaf saying Tehran must 'both fight and negotiate.' The warnings followed Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia.

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet announced the killing in Gaza of Nukhba commander Basir Al-Barsh and two Hamas operatives, Yahya Hamdouna and Muhammad Rafaei, who took part in the October 7 2023 attack. The IDF also said soldiers apprehended the gunman behind a shooting attack in the Neve Tzuf area after he fled to a nearby hospital.

threads.label: Sacred Defence Week messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and IRGC-affiliated Defa Press ran a heavy cycle marking the 46th anniversary of Sacred Defence Week, with the acting defence minister ('Ibn al-Reza') asserting Iran's defensive power is 'the product of the first imposed war' and IRGC commander Valizada claiming 'America knelt before the Iranian nation.' Coverage framed current deterrent capability as continuous with the Iran-Iraq war legacy.

threads.label: Death of Grand Ayatollah Shabiri Zanjani
threads.summary: IRIB announced the death of Grand Ayatollah Seyyed Musa Shabiri Zanjani, described as 'the supreme authority of the Shia world,' with funeral details to follow. IRGC commander Vahidi and Ayatollah Sobhani issued condolences characterising him as a pillar of the Shia seminaries.

events.title_en: Maritime incident in the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary_en: Maritime incident in the Strait of Hormuz. The UK Maritime Trade Operations organisation (UKMTO) announced today, Monday, that a tanker passing through the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unidentified projectile. According to the report, two crew members suffered minor injuries as a result of this incident. The UK Maritime Trade Operations organisation has not released further details about the vessel's identity, flag or the party responsible for this attack.

events.title_en: Note: A look at the dimensions of 'national cohesion' from the perspective of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution
events.summary_en: Note: A look at the dimensions of 'national cohesion' from the perspective of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution. The RAHBAR.IR media outlet, in a note entitled 'The secret of achieving a stronger Iran', based on the messages of His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Khamenei, has examined the dimensions of the 'social cohesion' issue. The divine blessing of 'national unity and social cohesion' is among the key concepts raised by the Supreme Leader of the Revolution, which has been continuously repeated and emphasised from his first message to date. In his first message, the Supreme Leader explicitly introduced unity as the factor that brings about the enemy's defeat: 'Currently, as a result of a strange unity among you fellow citizens, despite all differences of origin'.
